item.title: Build 707
item.description:
• Notes list grouped by day. Notes sit under Today, Yesterday and then the date, with the title on the first line and the start time beside it. The project tag, summary and length are on the second line, so titles are no longer cut short.
  • Transcript reads in turns. Fragments from the same speaker are one paragraph under a single name and time, so a conversation takes far less space. Speakers are never shown as an email address, and lines no longer start with a stray space.
  • Time tab header no longer breaks. The title and buttons stay on one line each in a narrow pane, and the controls move to a second row when the pane is tight.
  • Wrapped bullets line up. The second line of a bullet, numbered item or task starts under the first letter of the first line, at every indent.
  • One look for project codes and dates. A project's code looks the same in the notes list, Todo, Log, Mail and Upcoming. Dates and times read the same everywhere, for example Thu 6 Nov and 10:00 am.
  • Regenerate is quieter. It is now a text link at the end of the Meeting context row instead of a button in its own band under every summary.
  • Copy or export a transcript. On the Transcription tab, two buttons beside the chat button copy the whole transcript or save it as a Markdown file. Both are also in the ··· menu, so the transcript tab does not have to be open. Consecutive lines from the same speaker are joined into one turn, each starting with its time and the speaker's name as the transcript shows it.
  • Fold away what sits above the note. Click the heading of Follow-up meeting, Waiting on you, Suggested for the log or To raise here to fold it to one line, with its count (or, for a follow-up, the meeting and day) still showing. Mayfly remembers which are folded across notes, so a busy meeting no longer pushes the note itself off the screen.
